proof_body:
by
  intro a b c h habc
  have h2 : b * a = c ^ 2 := by rw [Nat.mul_comm]; exact habc
  have hu : IsUnit (gcd a b) := by
    rw [gcd_eq_nat_gcd, Nat.isUnit_iff]
    exact h
  have hu2 : IsUnit (gcd b a) := by
    rw [gcd_eq_nat_gcd, Nat.isUnit_iff]
    exact h.symm
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_eq_pow_of_mul_eq_pow hu habc
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_eq_pow_of_mul_eq_pow hu2 h2
  exact ⟨⟨s, hs⟩, ⟨t, ht⟩⟩
target_source: ∀ (a b c : ℕ), Nat.Coprime a b → a * b = c ^ 2 → (∃ s : ℕ, a = s ^ 2) ∧ (∃ t : ℕ, b = t ^ 2)
